steps.label: State the logarithmic form

write the sinh inverse logarithmic form

steps.label: Substitute x = 5
steps.margin_note: Second mark. 25 + 1 = 26, and √26 does not simplify — the surd is the final form.
lines: Given sinh x = 5, so x = Sinh⁻¹(5)

accept: substitute five to get log of five plus root twenty six
twenty five plus one is twenty six
the answer is log five plus root twenty six
five substitute cheste log five plus root twenty six vasthundi
x is log of five plus root twenty six

steps.why: 26 has no square factor, so √26 stands as it is. Trying to simplify it is wasted effort.
